title: 第3章 保证你可以觉醒辅助职业第4章 恶来雪上加霜
slug: 御兽别人鉴定都是骗你开神兽
content_zh:
;;
在他左手边，身影同样如同标枪一般笔直的人影淡淡回到。
“没必要。”
与此同时，他右手边的身影用几乎是一个模子中刻出来的音色说到。
“没有神的指引，不要做无用功。”
为首那人也不争辩。
三只s级御兽圣光狮鹫同时出现在三人身前。
一阵风沙吹过，空中已经没有了三位骑士的身影。
-----------------
陈小草缩在劳工市场的一颗残缺柱子后，躲避帝国寒冬凛冽的风。
当夕阳最后一丝光线被地平线吞噬之后，陈小草从单薄的衣裳中伸出了头。
那些高贵的副职业制造师们结束了一天的劳作，傍晚时分，就是该清理‘战场’的时候了。
果然，没等多久，几个身穿厚实衣服的人影就出现在劳工市场里。
其中一个，身上的衣服竟然还有御兽皮肤的光韵。
他肯定不会冷吧？
陈小草羡慕的瞥了那人一眼，然后开始行动。
动作比她快的人还有很多。
几乎是在瞬间，劳工市场就被各种嘈杂的声音充斥。
“我力气大，能搬运大块尸块，十二点前保证完工，只要120帝国币！”
“我精通各种御兽药剂知识，可以辨别出残余御兽植株价值，我要到药剂店工作，280帝国币一晚，收益37分。”

“我不要钱，只要无毒御兽残骸，30公斤肉，我就可以干一晚上！”
陈小草努力的往前挤，却挤不过那些身强体壮的男人们。
她那柔和的声音，也被各种嘈杂的音色完全掩盖。
她也不在意，只是卖力的往前挤着，就当是锻炼身体了。
一波接一波的人来，带走了一个个他们看得顺眼的临时劳工。
陈小草不厌其烦的往前挤着。
有几次都甚至挤到了最前面，可她那单薄的身体，一看就不是能干重活的，根本没人选她。
渐渐的，劳工越来越少，来的人也越来越少。
剩下没找到活的劳工看到没有多少人来，也渐渐散去。
陈小草依旧在石柱后面蹲着，坚持着。
以前，她的杂活都是这么捡漏来的。
她能熬，能忍。
夏天，她比别人更耐热，冬天，她比别人更耐寒。
她运气一向不错，每晚总能‘捡漏’那么一两个杂活。
今天也不例外。
当所有劳工都离开后的一个小时，在城镇大门即将关闭之前，陈小草终于等到了雇主。
content_en:
;;
To his left, a figure with the same figure as straight as a javelin faintly returned.
"No need."
At the same time, the figure on his right spoke with a tone that was almost carved from the same mold.
“Don’t do useless work without God’s guidance.”
The leader did not argue.
Three S-level beast-controlling Holy Light Griffins appeared in front of the three people at the same time.
A gust of wind and sand blew by, and the three knights were no longer in the air.
------------------
Chen Xiaocao huddled behind a broken pillar in the labor market to avoid the biting wind of the cold winter in the empire.
When the last ray of the setting sun was swallowed up by the horizon, Chen Xiaocao stretched out his head from his thin clothes.
Those noble sub-professional manufacturers have finished their work for the day, and in the evening, it is time to clean up the ‘battlefield’.
Sure enough, it didn't take long before several figures wearing thick clothes appeared in the labor market.
One of them actually had the luster of the beast's skin on his clothes.
Surely he won't be cold?
Chen Xiaocao glanced at the man with envy, and then started to take action.
There are many people who move faster than her.
Almost instantly, the labor market was filled with all kinds of noisy voices.
"I'm very strong and can carry large pieces of corpses. I guarantee it will be completed before twelve o'clock for only 120 imperial coins!"
"I am proficient in all kinds of beast-control potions and can identify the value of the remaining beast-control plants. I want to work in the pharmacy for 280 imperial coins a night and a profit of 37 points."
"I don't want money, I just want the non-toxic beast remains and 30 kilograms of meat, and I can do it all night!"
Chen Xiaocao tried his best to push forward, but couldn't squeeze through the strong men.
Her soft voice was completely obscured by all kinds of noisy sounds.
She didn't care, she just squeezed forward as hard as she could to exercise.
Wave after wave of people came and took away temporary workers who they liked.
Chen Xiaocao pushed forward tirelessly.
A few times she even squeezed to the front, but her thin body showed that she was not capable of doing heavy work, and no one chose her at all.
Gradually, there are fewer and fewer workers, and fewer and fewer people come.
The remaining laborers who had not found a job gradually dispersed when they saw that not many people came.
Chen Xiaocao still squatted behind the stone pillar and persisted.
In the past, this was how she got all her chores.
She can endure it.
In summer, she is more heat-resistant than others, and in winter, she is more cold-resistant than others.
She has always been very lucky and can always pick up one or two chores every night.
Today is no exception.
An hour after all the workers left, before the town gate was about to close, Chen Xiaocao finally waited for his employer.
